name: codedotnet-sandbox
description: Sandboxed single-file C# compile-and-run tool, backed by the CodeDotNet.Engine Roslyn/wasm pipeline. Every request runs in a disposable, hard-timeout-enforced child process.

transports.note: Start with `npm run serve` from codedotnet-sandbox. Used by the browser MCP Playground in codedotnet.web; not part of the standard MCP client transports.

tools.name: compile_and_run
tools.description: Compiles and executes a single-file C# program using the curated CodeDotNet reference surface, inside a disposable, hard-timeout-enforced sandbox process.
